verdict.rationale: Business onboarding speed is a fair question for a business banking platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents how long Wise Business onboarding takes or claims setup within about a week. Claims about creating accounts in 160+ countries and fast payment delivery describe account coverage and transfer speed, not onboarding time.

support.subject: As a founder, I can fully onboard onto a new banking platform in about a week instead of months
